name: Parmesan-Corn Fritters with Spinach, Avocado & Roasted Pepper Salad

instructions.primary_message: Place corn in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Place on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry, then transfer to a medium bowl.
Add eggs, cheese, flour, and spices to the bowl with the corn. Stir to combine the batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 eggs
⅔ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
1 tsp chili powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; press down to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Place in a clean medium bowl.
Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl with the spinach.
Drain and roughly chop roasted peppers. Add to the bowl along with vinaigrette, salt, and pepper. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (340 g) jar roasted red bell peppers
¼ cup French vinaigrette
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide fritters and salad between plates. Enjoy!
